title: 1990 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement:
The grading scale shown is used at Jones Junior High. The fifteen scores in Mr. Freeman’s class were: \(89,\) \(72,\) \(54,\) \(97,\) \(77,\) \(92,\) \(85,\) \(74,\) \(75,\) \(63,\) \(84,\) \(78,\) \(71,\) \(80,\) \(90.\)

 A \(93\text{--}100\)

 B \(85\text{--}92\)

 C \(75\text{--}84\)

 D \(70\text{--}74\)

 F \(0\text{--}69\)

In Mr. Freeman’s class, what percent of the students received a grade of C?

solutions.text:
A grade of C corresponds to scores from \(75\) to \(84\). The qualifying scores are \(77,\) \(75,\) \(84,\) \(78,\) \(80\), which is \(5\) students.

So the percent is \(\dfrac{5}{15} = \dfrac13 = 33\dfrac13\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Count how many scores fall in the range \(75\text{--}84\)
Divide that count by the \(15\) students to get the fraction, then convert to a percent
